message: No detected untrusted source handling: No checksum verification, pinned revisions, signed URLs, or authentication mechanisms are present when fetching datasets from any remote or external source.

No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation against expected sets, or label-noise detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are present anywhere in the data preparation code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious input filtering are applied to training samples in any of the data preparation code paths.

No detected model integrity verification: The code calls `load(config['model_config']['load_model'])` to load a serialized model but performs no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision validation before using it.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, verifies expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms such as neural cleanse, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation mechanism, hashing/signing of evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected output bounds checks: No code in the visible inference path checks model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or any other sanity checks before returning results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the pipeline supports text models (TransformerModel, wikitext2, amazonreviewfull), there is no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, output content moderation, or jailbreak detection implemented anywhere in the visible code.
